sourceAsset: Pro Longbow Pack / Erika Archer With Bow Arrow.fbx (Mixamo) - the 82-vertex arrow mesh that was removed from archer_mobile_v1.glb per its brief section 7
type: static projectile mesh - no skin, no skeleton, no animation

orientation.origin: the nock plane - the rear face of the arrow sits exactly at z = 0
orientation.forward: +Z points from the nock to the tip
orientation.why: This origin drops straight onto the sockets already shipped in archer_mobile_v1.manifest.json: parent the arrow to the 'nock' socket (mixamorig:RightHand, localPosition 0,0,0) with an identity local transform while 11_DRAW_ARROW / 12_AIM_OVERDRAW play, and it sits on the string pointing down the aim axis with no extra maths.

material.name: Arrow_MAT
material.alphaNote: Alpha is load-bearing here, unlike the other assets in this set: both the knapped flint head silhouette and the three feather vanes are alpha cut-outs in the source texture (14.3% of texels are fully transparent). Dropping alpha would turn the head and the feathers into rectangular slabs, so alphaMode MASK is required.
material.doubleSidedNote: Also required: the three fletching vanes are flat single-sided quads. At 80 triangles the cost of double-siding the whole primitive is nil, so it stays one material and one draw call.
material.normalMapNote: Arrow_NM.jpg was not shipped. The source mesh carries no tangents, so using it would mean generating and storing a TANGENT attribute (82 x 16 B) plus a second texture - more bytes than the entire model, for a 75 cm object seen in flight or stuck in a target at mob distance.

texture.source: Arrow_DIFF.png 512x512 RGBA (285 KB inside the source FBX)
texture.final: 256x256 WebP with alpha 13.8 KB (primary) + 256x256 PNG8/128-colour with alpha 19.3 KB (fallback)
texture.fallbackNote: A plain 256 RGBA PNG fallback would have been 90.9 KB - 83% of the whole file. Palettising it to 128 colours brings it to 19.3 KB with a mean RGB error of 3/255, and the alpha-MASK silhouette at cutoff 0.5 is bit-identical to the WebP on 100.000% of texels (0 flipped texels of 65,536).

runtime.note: EXT_texture_webp is USED, not REQUIRED - the PNG fallback means any conformant glTF 2.0 loader opens the file. No Draco, no Meshopt, no KTX2.

integration.nocked: arrow.position.set(0,0,0); arrow.quaternion.identity(); nockSocket.add(arrow)  // socket data is in archer_mobile_v1.manifest.json
integration.stuckInTarget: place so the tip lands on the impact point and the shaft trails behind: arrow.position.copy(hitPoint).addScaledVector(dir, -0.7504 * buried) where buried ~0.85 leaves about 11 cm of the head inside the target
integration.collisionNote: The tip is at local (0,0,0.7504). If your projectile integrates the tip rather than the nock, offset by that vector or read the arrow_tip node.

validation.checks: 27 structural, geometric, orientation and texture checks - all passed
knownIssues: The source mesh is only 80 triangles and the shaft has vertex rings at the two ends only - there are no rings along its length. That is fine for a straight arrow but the shaft cannot bend; do not try to animate a flex on this mesh.
Three non-manifold edges where the flat fletching vanes meet the shaft. Harmless for rendering; only matters if you feed this mesh to a physics convex-hull or CSG routine.
